secondary_audiences: People who can contribute expertise, relationships, or practical support.
People funding, partnering with, or evaluating OM's regional purpose.
primary_question: Can Opportunity Machine help me make progress on what I am building, and what should I do next?

sections.purpose: State OM's institutional identity and participation economics immediately after the protected hero.
sections.headline: Opportunity Machine is an economic-development organization.

sections.purpose: Let a founder begin with a real question instead of knowing an OM program name.
sections.headline: Start with what you need.
sections.body: I have an idea. I am building. I am growing. I need technical help. I am not sure where to begin.
sections.action: Route each need to a confirmed support explanation or the primary conversation action.

sections.purpose: Explain what support is currently available and how a founder accesses it.
sections.headline: How OM can help
sections.body: Public copy is blocked until the current program set, mentor access, technical support, workspace, membership, fees, eligibility, and participation process are confirmed.
sections.action: Link to current, confirmed service details.

sections.purpose: Show attributed founder experience without converting video presence into an outcome claim.
sections.headline: Hear from founders.
sections.body: Use only the approved GlowSens, Mallard Bay, and Keepers video embeds. Do not add company outcomes, funding figures, or causal claims without separate cleared records.

sections.purpose: Connect founder support to OM's economic-development purpose without asserting measured regional effects.
sections.headline: Why this work matters here
sections.body: The exact economic-development explanation remains proposed. It must distinguish OM's purpose from measured company or regional performance.
sections.action: Link to About or a later approved Impact and Acadiana page.

sections.purpose: Offer one low-friction human next step.
sections.headline: Tell us what you're building.

claims.statement: Opportunity Machine is an economic-development organization.
claims.limitations: Does not establish government-agency status, public funding, or a measured regional effect.
Does not establish no fees, no conditions, funding availability, IP terms, or eligibility.
